modeling_decisions: Concept canoe cavity and third-vane direction useful, but bead-like dorsal ornaments and tall sail exaggerate. Build one continuous closed thin three-vane fossil volume with two upcurved lateral quilted wings, modest central upright quilted vane along common keel seam, glide-offset unbranched module relief. No dorsal beads, roots or mouth. Small irregular matrix supports lower keel; display posture inferential, not living reconstruction.
repair: Visible supporting matrix contact corrected; slightly lower lateral rims expose canoe recess without camera changes. Original three-vane fossil specimen scope preserved.
